plugins.description: The Deccan Fine Chemicals corporate design system (v2.1+). Default for any stylized deliverable — documents, reports, memos, specs, policies, letters, proposals, decks, workbooks, dashboards, signatures — in HTML / PDF / Word / Excel / PowerPoint / Google Workspace, whether or not Deccan is mentioned. Attributes every document to the requesting user.
